entities.name: Patron kami
entities.description: Great spirits representing the collective consciousness of each sentient species of Kamigawa, honored and prayed to.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where each sentient race had a patron kami.

entities.name: Massacre at Reito
entities.description: Event before which every sentient race had a patron kami.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: Believed to have had audiences with the kitsune patron kami.

entities.name: Kitsune
entities.description: Race whose patron kami was consulted by Eight-and-a-Half-Tails.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: Took the role of patron of the Moonfolk in the original storyline.

entities.name: Moonfolk
entities.description: Race for which Mochi became patron.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Race that appealed to the Kirin to become their new patrons after the war.

entities.name: Kirin
entities.description: Refused to become the Orochi's patrons.

events.summary: Small groups in each tribe offer living sacrifices to pacify the raging patron kami.
events.quote: small groups that offered living sacrifices to the raging patrons

events.summary: After the war the Orochi ask the Kirin to be their patrons, but the Kirin refuse.
events.quote: after the war the Orochi appealed to the Kirin to become their new patrons, but they refused

relations.note: took the role of patron of the Moonfolk
relations.quote: Mochi took the role of patron of the Moonfolk
